lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Nvidia is leading a tremendous rally on Wall Street Monday following the surprise return of Jensen Huang as its CEO, The Canadian Press reports.

Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, claiming that maritime drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault the previous day, The Canadian Press reports.
A museum that has stood on the Acropolis since 1874, making it the oldest in modern Greece, reopened Monday after a hi-tech makeover, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
